plugins.name: behavior-harness
plugins.description: Hooks that steer Claude away from specific bad behaviors: chained Bash commands, git staging/history mutations, and early git flags (git -C <dir>, git -c key=value, git --no-pager, ...) that defeat permission rules.

plugins.name: documentation-manager
plugins.description: Skills that steer how Claude writes and maintains documentation, starting with markdown formatting rules.

plugins.name: reference-skills
plugins.description: A vendored bundle of third-party reference skills (Jetpack Compose, Robolectric, and more over time), installed as one plugin.
